transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

My family wanted me to come. They keep saying the bank papers show nothing was taken, but… I know what’s going on. It’s been over a year. They’re hiding my money, using bills and fundraisers and trip plans to cover it. I just need them to tell the truth.
Do you ever hear voices when no one is there?
No… I don’t think so. Not like that.
Have there been times when you felt unusually energetic and needed much less sleep than usual?
Not really. I mean… I sleep bad sometimes, but I don’t think I’ve had that thing where I’m full of energy and don’t need sleep.
Do you ever feel that someone can put thoughts into your mind?

No… not putting thoughts in my head. It’s more… I already know what they’re doing with my money, even if they keep saying the papers don’t show it. They’re covering it with bills and trips and all that.
Have you found yourself pulling away from other people or losing interest in things you used to enjoy?
I don’t know… maybe a little. I still talk to people when I have to. I just don’t really feel like being around everyone much.
Aside from the issue with your money, do you believe anyone is trying to harm you or plot against you?

Not… harm me, no. It’s more about the money. My family and some friends keep saying the bank papers don’t show anything, but I know they’re hiding it. They use bills, fundraisers, trip plans… things like that to cover where it went. I just want them to tell the truth.
Even when the bank papers show nothing was taken, are you certain your money was stolen?

Yes. I’m sure. The papers don’t show it because they’re hiding it… with bills and fundraisers and trip plans, all of that. I’ve known for over a year. That’s why I keep asking them about it. They need to tell the truth.
Have you lost motivation to do your usual daily activities?

Not really. I mean… besides the arguing about the money, I still do what I need to do. I make my meals, go to the county clinic and those assistance appointments, keep my stuff in order. Same as before.
Because of this, have you had trouble keeping up with work or your usual responsibilities?

No… I don’t have a job right now, but I keep up with my things. I still make my meals, go to the county clinic and the assistance appointments, keep my stuff in order. It’s mostly just the arguments about the money.
Do people ever tell you that your speech is hard to follow or doesn’t make sense?
Not really. I mean… sometimes people say I’m upset, but not that I don’t make sense.
Have you ever seen things that other people could not see?
No… I don’t think so. I haven’t seen anything like that.
Before all this started, did you ever feel that ordinary events or comments were secretly directed at you?

Not really before… I don’t know. This is more about the money. For over a year I’ve known they’re hiding it, and then they act like bills or fundraisers or trips explain it away. My family says the bank papers don’t prove anything, but they do. I just need them to tell the truth.
Do you often feel that other people are trying to cheat or take advantage of you?

Yes… with my family and some friends. They keep saying the bank papers don’t show anything, but I know money is being hidden. It’s been over a year, and they use bills or fundraisers or trip plans like excuses. I just keep asking them because I need them to admit it.
At any time since this started, have you had a period when your thoughts felt jumbled or hard to organize?
I don’t know… not really jumbled. I get upset and think about the same things a lot, but I don’t think my thoughts are hard to organize.
Is the main thing you believe happening that your family is hiding or stealing your money?

Yes. That’s… that’s the main thing. My family, and some friends too, keep saying the bank papers don’t prove anything, but I know money is being hidden. They use bills and fundraisers and trips to cover it up. I just need them to tell the truth.
Before the money problem started, did you generally mistrust other people?
I don’t really know. I mean… I didn’t think about people that way much before. Not like this.
